answer: Fund shared projects with pairwise-bounded quadratic matching. If a hundred clones each chip in a little toward mapping the inlet that feeds a silted lagoon, the matching bonus is discounted for every pair of backers who keep co-funding the same proposals. Clones always move together, so their boost collapses to about one donor's worth, while scattered strangers backing a walnut-orchard soil survey keep the full match, since their histories barely overlap.
